scope: Confirmatory six-graph n18 PageRank timing campaign plus five compact-eligible full-graph width comparisons. It isolates compact ReusePlan transport and structural FlowThrough while replacement stays pure LRU in both arms.

semantic_receipt_provenance.graph_source: Generated literature-scale corpus n18 DBG samples.
semantic_receipt_provenance.reason_for_t0: Disable convergence-based early exit so requested and executed iteration counts match.
semantic_receipt_provenance.receipt_source: Graph identity, cache geometry, and iteration-1/iteration-8 semantic receipts are copied unchanged from pagerank_literature_scale.json; they are not re-derived here.

policies.note: Both arms select victims with pure LRU. The candidate differs only in graph representation, request path, and record transport.

record_format.compact_record_feasibility: Every n18 timing sample uses 18 destination bits, 2 tier bits, and two 4-bit epochs: 28 total bits.

full_graph_compact_exclusions.soc-LiveJournal1: The full graph needs 23 destination bits; 23 + 2 tier bits + two 4-bit epochs = 33 bits, so no 32-bit compact record exists for this role.

roles.60_gem5_proposal_reuse_bind_o3: Mechanism existence and binding evidence. Complete and valid rows are required, and its timing is never admissible.
roles.96_gem5_transport_i1: Screen timing: six-graph iteration-1 gem5 O3 PageRank, LRU versus the compact transport candidate under symmetric structural FlowThrough.
roles.97_gem5_transport_i8: Robustness timing: the same six graphs at iteration 8.
roles.98_cache_sim_transport_wide16: Five-graph 8-byte wide-record cache_sim control over the compact-eligible corpus.
roles.99_cache_sim_transport_compact16: Five-graph 4-byte compact-record cache_sim role matched cell-for-cell against the wide control.
roles.100_sniper_transport_matched: Bounded matched-work Sniper corroboration of demand LLC misses with 8-byte transport records.

metrics.sniper_llc_miss_field_note: Sniper l3_misses is its demand LLC load-miss count. It excludes writeback bytes and is not an off-chip traffic metric; the Sniper role therefore supports only a demand-LLC-miss non-regression statement.

decision.threshold_basis: The 0.98 and 1.02 limits are the existing frozen +/-2% tie band: 0.98 is required for a positive aggregate timing or compact-width claim, while 1.02 is the maximum material-regression bound.

prior_evidence.classification: Exploratory evidence used to choose a confirmatory transport-only scope. These rows are not reused as campaign evidence.
prior_evidence.comparison: LRU versus ECG_REUSE_PLAN_LRU_FLOWTHROUGH under symmetric structural FlowThrough at iteration 1.
prior_evidence.exclusion_reason: The confirmatory campaign uses a new commit, manifest, sidecar version, simulator binary, and gate receipt. Earlier rows cannot authorize or populate it.

amendments.reason: The first authorized full cache cell showed that global symmetric structural FlowThrough intentionally supersedes the candidate's duplicate static record FlowThrough path, but roi_matrix still required both receipt banners. Version 2 records the subsumption explicitly and accepts it only when structural FlowThrough is active and positive.

resource_scope.screen: Both arms keep the full 16-way LLC data capacity and identical cache geometry.

charged_in_roi.reuse_plan: 4-byte replacement records substituted for the CSR destination array plus FlowThrough placement

allowed_claims: Compact ReusePlan record transport plus structural FlowThrough changes PageRank execution time and off-chip traffic relative to an identical LRU cell that also runs structural FlowThrough.

On the five full graphs whose destination identifiers fit the 32-bit format, the 4-byte compact record substitutes for the CSR destination array with matched semantic outputs against the 8-byte wide control.
Bounded matched-work Sniper rows show whether demand LLC load misses remain within the frozen 1.02 non-regression bound under 8-byte transport records.
disallowed_claims: Any ReusePlan replacement-policy claim; victim selection is pure LRU in both arms of this campaign.
Any comparison against SRRIP, GRASP, P-OPT, or any other replacement baseline.
Any timing claim from Sniper rows or from the mechanism stage.
Any Sniper off-chip byte-traffic claim; the Sniper role reports demand LLC load misses and excludes writeback bytes.
Any compact full-graph claim for soc-LiveJournal1, whose 33-bit field budget does not fit the 32-bit format.
Any hardware-cost or area advantage claim.
Any claim drawn from runs produced under a different commit, manifest, or transport configuration.

replacement_campaign_relationship.authority: The replacement campaign's own receipts remain authoritative for replacement claims and are neither reused nor revised here.

sequence: Run stage 60 and stage 96 together and evaluate the screen phase.
A screen GO receipt bound to git HEAD, the manifest hash, and this configuration hash authorizes stages 97, 98, 99, and 100.
Run stages 97 through 100, then evaluate the complete phase.
execution.note: Run whole cells without policy sharding. ReusePlan records and DBG order are precomputed once.

sampling_caveat: Architectural timing uses uniform n18 samples. Full-graph record-width, traffic, and semantic-substitution evidence comes from the cache_sim roles; Sniper adds bounded matched-work corroboration only.
